compliance.key.required_body.default: Quill is bring-your-own-key: it transcribes using your own provider account (e.g. Groq or OpenAI). Without a key, Quill can't transcribe. Your key is encrypted on this device and never sent to us.

compliance.key.required_title.default: You'll need your own API key

compliance.privacy.promise.default: Quill has no account and runs no server. Your audio and transcripts stay on this device except for the direct, encrypted call to the provider you chose.

compliance.privacy.welcome_pill.default: Your key, your audio - nothing through our servers

compliance.rationale.accessibility.default: Quill uses accessibility only to detect the focused text field and insert your dictation. It never reads or writes password or banking fields.

compliance.rationale.mic.default: Quill needs the microphone to record what you dictate. Audio is sent only to the speech provider whose key you supply, and is deleted after a successful transcription.

compliance.rationale.overlay.default: The floating bubble needs permission to display over other apps. That bubble is also what lets Quill record while you're in another app.

history.clear.body.default: This removes all %1$d saved dictations from this device. It can't be undone.

history.empty.off_body.default: Turn on Save dictation history in Settings to keep transcripts on this phone.

history.empty.on_body.default: Once you start dictating, your transcripts show up here - saved on this phone only.

models.fallback.default: Could not refresh. Showing saved or built-in choices.

models.ranking.default: Free compatible models appear first, followed by dictation or cleanup candidates. Free-tier quotas apply; check your provider plan. Preview models can change or disappear.

onboarding.allset.body.default: The bubble is live. Open any app, focus a text field, and give it a try.

onboarding.allset.look.default: Look for this in the corner of your screen.

onboarding.howitworks.step1.default: The bubble starts listening - tap again to send.

onboarding.howitworks.step2.default: Audio goes straight to your speech-to-text key. No middleman.

onboarding.howitworks.step3.default: Text drops in at the cursor - chat, email, search, notes.

onboarding.howitworks.title.default: From voice to text, on your terms

onboarding.key.body.default: A key is a private code from an AI service. It lets Quill send your voice directly to that service and receive text over an encrypted connection. Never share your key with anyone.

onboarding.key.browser_error.default: The browser could not open. Try again after choosing a default browser in Android settings.

onboarding.key.console_body.default: Any of these works - pick one for quick steps to get its key. Your key stays on this device.

onboarding.key.format_help.default: Paste the complete key, beginning like %1$s. Do not paste a masked key or a web address.

onboarding.key.free_note.default: Free-tier limits apply. Paid accounts may be billed under their plan. Quill checks your key without sending audio; successful dictation also depends on your model access and available quota.

onboarding.key.guide.gemini_steps.default:
Open Google AI Studio using the button below. Sign in with your Google account.
If the welcome agreement appears, read the terms and check the first, required checkbox if you agree and meet its requirements. The email updates checkbox is optional. Tap Continue.
On API Keys, find your default key and tap its copy icon (two overlapping sheets). If no key appears, tap Create API key and follow the project prompts.
Return to Quill. Tap Paste below, wait for the green check, then save your key.

onboarding.key.guide.groq_steps.default:
Open Groq using the button below. Create an account or sign in.
Open API Keys, then choose Create API Key.
Give it a name you will recognize, such as Quill. Select No Expiration if you want it to keep working until you revoke it. Create the key.
Tap the copy button beside your new key. Keep it private.
Return to Quill. Tap Paste below, wait for the green check, then save your key.

onboarding.key.guide.openai_steps.default:
1. Sign in at platform.openai.com.
2. Open API keys and tap Create new secret key.
3. Copy the key right away - it's shown only once - then paste it into Quill.
4. New accounts usually need a small billing credit before the key will transcribe.

onboarding.key.guide.openrouter_steps.default:
Open OpenRouter using the button below. Sign up or sign in.
If asked how you plan to use OpenRouter, choose Individual for your personal account.
If a new key is shown, tap its copy icon. Otherwise open Keys in your account menu, choose Create Key, name it Quill, and copy the new key.
Return to Quill. Tap Paste below, wait for the green check, then save your key.

onboarding.key.read_steps.default: I have read the steps. I will return to Quill to paste my key.

onboarding.key.router_note.default: Free cleanup models are available. Speech transcription may require credits. Quill prefers a free compatible speech model when the live catalog offers one. Checking your key does not spend model credits.

onboarding.key.storage_error.default: We could not save your key securely. Keep this screen open and try again.

onboarding.key.unverified.default: We could not reach the provider to check this key. Your draft is kept securely. Check your connection, then try again.

onboarding.key.warning.free_tier.default: You bring the key - some providers (like Groq) have a free tier to start.

onboarding.key.warning.reading.default: Take a moment to read this

onboarding.key.warning.usage.default: Your provider may charge for usage - Quill itself is free.

onboarding.key.where_link.default: Where do I get a key?

onboarding.mic.blocked.default: Microphone access is off. Open Quill's app settings, choose Permissions, then allow Microphone. Return here to test it.

onboarding.mic.denied.default: Microphone access is needed to record your voice. Tap Allow microphone to try again.

onboarding.mictest.body.default: Let's check your mic. Speak now - you should see the strokes move.

onboarding.welcome.body.default: A bubble floats over every app. Tap it, speak, and your words land right where the cursor is.

onboarding.welcome.title.default: Dictate into any app you use

reliability.boot.text.default: Your phone restarted. Open Quill to bring the bubble back.

settings.about.footer.default: Made for people who'd rather talk than type.

settings.advanced.battery_sub.default: Open battery settings → find Quill → allow unrestricted

settings.advanced.clear_confirm_body.default: This removes your saved key, clears your dictation history and custom words, and resets every setting on this device. It can't be undone.

settings.advanced.endpoint_help.default: For any OpenAI-compatible provider. Changing this re-validates your key.

settings.advanced.keepalive_sub.default: Helps on phones that kill apps

settings.advanced.reset_confirm_body.default: Restores all preferences to their defaults. Your API key and dictation history are kept.

settings.audio.silence_banner.default: In very noisy places this may not trigger - the max-length limit always applies.

settings.bubble.help.default: The light ring keeps the bubble visible on any background.

settings.cleanup.automatic_help.default: Use the speech provider's active key with a known free cleanup option. Automatic cleanup stays off when no free option is known. Free-tier quotas apply. Choosing a separate provider or model below is a manual choice and may cost money.

settings.cleanup.custom_endpoint.default: Custom cleanup shares the custom endpoint and key with transcription. Saving a different URL changes both.

settings.cleanup.groq_key.default: Cleanup always runs on Groq - it uses your saved Groq key, not your active provider's.

settings.cleanup.groq_missing.default: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key it's skipped and the raw transcript is inserted.

settings.cleanup.provider_help.default: Cleanup uses the selected provider and its saved key. All three writing styles apply here. If cleanup fails or takes too long, Quill keeps your original transcript.

settings.keys.banner.default: Keys are encrypted in this device's keystore and never leave it or appear in logs.

settings.keys.empty_body.default: Quill needs a speech-to-text key to transcribe. Add one to start dictating again.

settings.keys.help.default: Your cleanup model reuses this key unless you add a separate one.

settings.privacy.banner_text.default: Audio goes only to your provider; everything else stays on this phone.

settings.privacy.crash_sub.default: Only if a crash happens - you review first

settings.privacy.diag_help.default: Reports include the error, app version and device - never your audio, text, clipboard, or key.

settings.privacy.history_sub.default: Kept on this phone, then auto-deleted

settings.speech.custom_url_help.default: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Quill calls <base URL>/audio/transcriptions with your key.

settings.speech.gemini_caveat.default: Gemini is a chat model asked to transcribe - spoken commands may occasionally be paraphrased instead of written word-for-word.

settings.speech.key_required.default: No API key saved for %1$s yet. Add one to dictate with this provider.

settings.speech.language_help.default: English keeps mixed Hindi-English speech in Roman script ("aaj ka"). Auto-detect or Hindi give native script.

settings.speech.model_field_hint.default: Exact model ID from your provider

settings.style.formal_sub.default: Full sentences, always punctuated, no contractions

settings.style.help.default: Style is picked from the app you were in when you started speaking. Custom words are still applied last.

settings.style.intro.default: Match how you write in each app - more formal at work, more relaxed with friends.

settings.style.needs_cleanup.default: Writing style rides on the AI cleanup pass - turn on "Clean up with AI" for it to apply.

settings.style.needs_groq.default: Cleanup runs on Groq only. Without a saved Groq key, writing style won't be applied.

settings.style.neutral_sub.default: Sentence case, standard punctuation, as you said it

settings.style.words_promise.default: Style only changes punctuation, capitalization and contractions. It never changes your words.

settings.survival.body.default: Some phones (Honor, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung) aggressively stop background apps. To keep the bubble alive, allow Quill to auto-start / run in the background in your device's app-management settings.

settings.survival.fallback.default: Couldn't open it automatically on this device - open Settings ▸ Battery / App management and find Quill manually.

settings.survival.steps.default:
1. Open your device's app-launch or protected-apps settings.
2. Find Quill in the list.
3. Allow auto-start / background activity (and set battery to Unrestricted).

settings.vocab.body.default: Import names from your contacts so Quill can learn how the people you know are spelled. Names are stored only on this device and are never sent anywhere.

settings.vocab.clear_confirm_body.default: This removes every imported contact name from this device. Your custom words are not affected.

settings.vocab.empty_sub.default: Import from contacts to see them here

settings.vocab.import_failed.default: Couldn't read contacts. The previous import was kept.

settings.vocab.permission_needed.default: Contacts access is needed to import names. You can grant it in system settings.

settings.words.body.default: Teach Quill names and terms it keeps mishearing. Each is matched and replaced after transcription.

settings.words.empty_sub.default: Tap + to add a name or term

settings.words.err_key.default: Add an API key in Settings to use voice capture.

settings.words.err_permission.default: Microphone access is needed to record.

stt.quota.toast.default: API usage has run out - check your provider plan.

system.recovery.banner_text.default: Your phone switched off Accessibility access - Quill can't insert text until it's back on.

system.recovery.body.default: Some phones turn this off to save battery. Turning it back on takes two taps.
